name: FMC LIVE - North America 2025
information:
# If you do not see a location near you, reach out to your local delegate to help them find a location!

Tune into the first live streamed FMC competition to watch the best competitors from North America vie for the win!

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. We will not be holding any other event. 

- This competition will take place at different venues across North America.  Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLIVENorthAmerica2025#46204-locations) for more details.

# Notice of Filming and Photography
Competitors and spectators of the event may end up on the Livestream.  By registering for or attending this competition you consent to your images being used in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
